changeSet.sql: UPDATE task_dependencies dependency SET project_id = item.project_id FROM wbs_items item WHERE dependency.successor_id = item.id AND dependency.project_id IS NULL

changeSet.author: NTDHTCT-26
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO task_dependencies ( id, project_id, predecessor_id, successor_id, dependency_type, lag_days, created_at ) SELECT legacy.id, legacy.project_id, legacy.predecessor_id, legacy.successor_id, legacy.dependency_type, legacy.lag_days, legacy.created_at FROM task_dependencies_s06 legacy WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task_dependencies current_dependency WHERE current_dependency.predecessor_id = legacy.predecessor_id AND current_dependency.successor_id = legacy.successor_id )

changeSet.author: NTDHTCT-26
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO task_dependencies ( id, project_id, predecessor_id, successor_id, dependency_type, lag_days, created_at ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), item.project_id, legacy.predecessor_id, legacy.successor_id, COALESCE(legacy.dependency_type, 'FS'), COALESCE(legacy.lag_days, 0), COALESCE(legacy.created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) FROM task_dependencies_s06 legacy JOIN wbs_items item ON item.id = legacy.successor_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task_dependencies current_dependency WHERE current_dependency.predecessor_id = legacy.predecessor_id AND current_dependency.successor_id = legacy.successor_id )
